project_type: Roblox Luau game (Pet Simulator with Battle Cats side mode)
build_system: Python script tools/generate_rbxlx.py regenerates BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx from src/ tree
test_framework: No automated tests - validation is via python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py (must succeed without errors)
verification_instructions: Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py from the project root. If it succeeds, the Lua source is syntactically valid and the project file is regenerated.
snapshot_or_generated_files: BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx is regenerated by tools/generate_rbxlx.py from the src/ directory tree
setup_instructions: python3 is available (3.9.25). No pip installs needed.
environment_constraints: No Roblox Studio available for runtime testing; validation is AST-level only via generate_rbxlx.py
contribution_requirements: Run python3 tools/generate_rbxlx.py after all changes to regenerate the .rbxlx file
key_patterns: Server-authoritative architecture. Services in src/ServerScriptService/Services/. Client controllers in src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/. Shared config/data in src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/. Remote events are defined in Main.server.lua and wired in Main.client.lua. PetData.Variants already lists Normal/Golden/Shiny/Rainbow. Golden conversion exists in PetService.convertToGoldenPet(). Discovery tracked in data.discoveredPets with keys like 'petId' (Normal) or 'Golden_petId' (Golden). EggService.purchaseAndHatch fires EggHatchStart then EggHatchResult events. EffectsController.completeEggHatch handles the reveal animation. UIController._createPetIndex and _refreshPetIndex show collection book with 'Coming Soon' for Shiny/Rainbow.
directory_structure: src/ServerScriptService/Services/ - server logic; src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/ - client controllers; src/ReplicatedStorage/Shared/ - shared data/config; tools/ - build scripts
